exact_result.statement: THEOREM (unconditional, no disk hypothesis, degree-free). Let f be monic of degree n >= 2 and mu = min_{f'(c)=0} |f(c)|, rho = mu^(1/n) = cap(K_mu). Zeros are listed with multiplicity. Then two zero occurrences of f are joined by a possibly degenerate path of length at most 8 rho lying inside K_{2mu} = {|f| <= 2mu}. The bound is affine invariant. Explicitly the constant is min over r in (0,1), lambda > 1 of 8r/(1-r)^2 + lambda^(1/n) (sqrt(log(lambda/r)) + pi/sqrt(log lambda)), the path then lying in K_{lambda mu}; at lambda = 2, r = 0.03 this is 7.592 at n = 3, 7.180 at n = 4, and 6.079 as n -> infinity, with the squarefree n = 2 branch settled separately and exactly at constant 2 by the root chord. COROLLARY: for roots in the OPEN UNIT DISK two zero occurrences are joined inside {|f| < 1} by a path of length at most 6.1 whenever mu <= 1/2, in particular whenever the root circumradius satisfies R <= 2^(-1/n), since Fekete gives mu <= R^n; and by a path of length Theta(mu) < infinity for every mu < 1, degrading only as mu -> 1. PROOF INGREDIENTS, all elementary. (i) LEMMA 1, the piece the directory recorded as unavailable: for a component C' of {|f| <= sigma} holding k' roots, H^1(dC')^2 <= 2 pi k' sigma A'(sigma), by Cauchy-Schwarz on the parameter phi = arg f (whose total increase is exactly 2 pi k') against the area derivative A'(sigma) = int_{dC'} |dz|/|f'|. Summed over sub-components this gives Lambda(sigma) <= sqrt(2 pi k sigma A'(sigma)). It is PER COMPONENT and DEGREE FREE, which is exactly what CapacityGeodesicConjecture.md section 8 says is missing when it retires the boundary-hop construction on the grounds that Eremenko-Hayman's 9.173 n is degree dependent. Eremenko-Hayman is not used anywhere. (ii) Area(C) <= pi cap(C)^2 <= pi t^(2/n) from Gronwall's area theorem plus cap(K_t) = t^(1/n); components of K_t are full because {|f| > t} has no bounded component. (iii) Koebe distortion on the CONFORMAL one-root lobes of {|f| < mu} (available exactly because mu is the minimal critical value) bounds each lift from a root up to level r mu by 4r/(1-r)^2 rho POINTWISE in the ray direction, using cr_i <= 4 cap(K_mu) = 4 rho from Koebe's quarter theorem. (iv) A' has a logarithmic divergence AT a critical level, which is why every earlier attempt to bound a pinched lobe's perimeter by Cauchy-Schwarz fails at mu itself; a mean-value choice of the working level t in [mu, lambda mu] against the measure d t / t removes it at the cost of the containment level. (v) The k lift endpoints at level t cut dC_t into k arcs of total length H^1(dC_t), so the best cyclically-adjacent pair costs at most (2 sum_i ell_i + H^1(dC_t)) / k. ISOLATED RESIDUE: CONJECTURE P, sharp with an explicit extremal -- a component of {|f| <= sigma} holding exactly one root has H^1(dC) <= Gamma(1/4)^2/(2 sqrt(pi)) sigma^(1/n) = sqrt(2) varpi sigma^(1/n) = 3.7081493546..., varpi the lemniscate constant, with equality exactly for quadratics at sigma = mu where the lobe boundary is one loop of Bernoulli's lemniscate. This is the ONE-ROOT PER-COMPONENT form of the Erdos-Herzog-Piranian lemniscate length problem and a genuinely different extremal problem: EHP's conjectured per-root constant is 2, attained asymptotically by z^n - 1, whereas the one-root maximum is sqrt(2) varpi, attained by a quadratic. THEOREM 3 (conditional): Conjecture P with constant beta gives a pair path inside K_mu ITSELF of length at most (8x/(1-x)^2 + (beta/pi) log(1/x) + beta) rho, about 7.4 rho at beta = sqrt(2) varpi, x = 0.1, hence constant-factor Erdos #1041 for EVERY polynomial with roots in the open unit disk with no proviso.
exact_result.measurement: Each inequality checked directly. Area(C_t)/(pi t^(2/n)) = 0.7901 / 0.8931 / 0.9557 / 0.0163 and Lemma 1's ratio H^1(dC_t)^2/(2 pi k t A'(t)) = 0.8583 / 0.8833 / 0.9101 / 0.8524 on the quadratic, a perturbed cubic, a near-Fekete quintic and a random sextic, so Lemma 1 is tight to 10-15 per cent and is not where the constant is lost. The assembled path returns 2.0006 rho on the near-Fekete quintic against the proved 7.6 rho. Conjecture P over 120 random configurations at degrees 2..10 in five families: max P/rho = 3.7081, attained only at quadratics and agreeing with Gamma(1/4)^2/(2 sqrt pi) to seven digits; max mean-lift/rho = 0.520; max branch-pair/2rho = 1.000. The measured cone angle |arg Xi|, Xi = (z-a) f'/f, reaches pi, independently reconfirming negative_results 25.
exact_result.instrument_defect: New location, same class as negative_results 34 and 41, found and fixed while building the probe. At a simple saddle the four local rays +-sqrt(+-2i w_0/f''(c*)) sit at 90 degrees to each other and one lobe is a single 90-degree sector bounded by the two nearest its descending direction. Choosing the two square-root signs independently -- the obvious coding -- traces the two halves of the lobe boundary on OPPOSITE lobes, returning a closure gap of order rho and a perimeter inflated to 6.54 rho on a random quadratic whose exact value is 3.7081 rho. The bias runs AGAINST the conjecture so it cannot have manufactured the record, but the closure gate silently EXCLUDED those rows: 280 of 400 rows in the first sweep were dropped and the sweep reported only 120. Fix: select both signs against the descending direction v = +-sqrt(-2 w_0/f''(c*)); the same quadratic then returns 3.7081491 with closure 2.2e-16. GENERAL RULE: a two-branch trace at a saddle must fix its signs from a common reference direction, never independently; and a silent exclusion gate must report its exclusion count alongside its record.
exact_result.claim_effect: Supplies the FIRST unconditional, degree-free bound on the pair geodesic recorded in this directory. It is strictly weaker than the target -- 8 > 2, and the containment level is 2 mu rather than mu -- and it is NOT an equivalent reformulation but a proved weakening. It leaves every sharp statement untouched: (C), (COVER), min_c L(c) <= 2R, the per-component combined charge and Claim L remain open, and Erdos #1041 remains open. It also retires section 8's near-miss verdict on the boundary-hop construction: that construction fails only for the SHARP constant, and Lemma 1 removes its stated dependence on Eremenko-Hayman.

claim_ceiling_addendum: NEW, 2026-08-24, the first unconditional bound on file: two zero occurrences are joined by a possibly degenerate path of length at most 8 mu^(1/n) = 8 cap(K_mu) inside {|f| <= 2 mu}, degree-free and affine invariant, hence inside the open unit lemniscate with length at most 6.1 whenever mu <= 1/2 (in particular whenever the root circumradius satisfies R <= 2^(-1/n)). The enabling lemma is per-component and elementary -- H^1(dC')^2 <= 2 pi k' sigma A'(sigma) by Cauchy-Schwarz on arg f against the area derivative, with the area controlled by Gronwall through cap(K_t) = t^(1/n) -- so the boundary-hop construction that CapacityGeodesicConjecture.md section 8 retired for depending on Eremenko-Hayman's degree-dependent 9.173 n now closes with an absolute constant. Erdos #1041 itself is untouched: 8 > 2, the constant 2 is sharp, and the residue is isolated as Conjecture P, that a ONE-ROOT component of {|f| <= sigma} has boundary length at most Gamma(1/4)^2/(2 sqrt pi) sigma^(1/n) = 3.7081493546..., sharp for quadratics, which would upgrade the theorem to containment in K_mu itself and remove the mu <= 1/2 proviso. Conjecture P is measured, not proved.
